question: Where is the headquarters of the National Rifle Association of India situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The headquarters of the National Rifle Association of India (NRAI) is situated in **New Delhi**.
 
• New Delhi is the capital city of India and serves as the center for many national-level organizations and associations.
 
• NRAI is the governing body for shooting sport in India, overseeing all aspects of the sport across the country.
 
• Being located in New Delhi allows NRAI to be in close proximity to various government bodies and sports authorities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Rifle Association of India (NRAI)**

 
 
• The NRAI was established in 1951 to promote and popularize the shooting sport in India.
 
• It is affiliated with the International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF), Asian Shooting Confederation (ASC), and Commonwealth Shooting Federation (CSF).
 
• The association conducts various national championships and trials to select shooters for international competitions.
 
• NRAI also provides training and support to aspiring shooters through various programs and initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Shooting Sport**
 
 
• Shooting is a sport that involves tests of proficiency (accuracy and speed) using various types of guns such as firearms and air guns.
 
• Competitions are held for both individual and team events, and they are classified by the type of firearm, distance, and shooting position.
 
• It is a part of the Olympic Games, and events are categorized into rifle, pistol, and shotgun disciplines.
 
• India has produced several renowned shooters who have won medals at the Olympics, World Championships, and other international events.
 
 
 
• **New Delhi**
 
 
• New Delhi is the capital of India and the seat of all three branches of the Government of India, namely the executive, the legislature, and the judiciary.
 
• It is one of the eleven districts of Delhi and the seat of the Government of the National Capital Territory of Delhi (NCT).
 
• New Delhi hosts various national institutions, including the Parliament of India, the Rashtrapati Bhavan (President's House), and the Supreme Court of India.
 
• The city is also known for its rich history, cultural heritage, and serves as a major hub for international diplomacy and commerce.
